snow_sensitivity.source: S = 1 + 0.5 x snow anomaly. Snow is only part of summer flow (glaciers, rain and reservoirs are the rest). 0.5 is set so that a typical low-snow year in Talas and Chuy (FLDAS: 50% below normal) gives S = 0.75; to calibrate with the water manager's short years

snow_factor_limits.source: Assumption: canals never get less than half or more than 110% of a normal season

pump_softening.source: Assumption: S_pump = 1 - 0.5 x (1 - S); a big river rarely runs dry

position_factor.source: Share of the allocation that reaches a field. 'normal' at S = 1 or more, 'low' at S = 0.75 or less, a straight line between. Assumption; to confirm with the water manager

position_low_at.source: The S at which the canal position factor reaches its low-year value

normal_year_factor.source: Farmer's answer to: in a normal year, is water enough?

effective_rain.source: FAO: about 70% of season rain is useful to the crop

short_fit.source: Fit below 0.9 counts as falling short

saver_share.source: Water-saver: net need at most 70% of the plan

heat_days_week.source: 5 or more hot days in the flowering week

frost_spare_days.source: Days to spare between crop season and frost-free season

slope_deg.source: Assumption: above 3 degrees water washes soil and seed; above 8 only hay or alfalfa. An agronomist should check

ndvi_most_years.source: Assumption: green (NDVI 0.5 or more) or bare (under 0.3) in more than half of the years 2013-2025

soil_class.source: Simplified texture classes from SoilGrids sand and clay percent

heavy_rain_share.source: Assumption: share of years with a day of 20 mm or more in the sowing weeks

sowing_weeks.source: Weeks after the earliest sowing date counted as the sowing period

dry_year_anomaly.source: Used only where a field is outside every basin: the mean of low-snow years in Talas and Chuy (FLDAS 2001-2025)

crop_tables.source: Stage lengths and crop coefficients are FAO's typical values, not measured in Kyrgyzstan; to check against the tables and with an agronomist

winter_restart_doy.source: Winter wheat and its irrigation are counted from 1 April

double_crop_spare_days.source: A second crop must mature 10 days before the first autumn frost

winter_sowing.source: Winter wheat in Kyrgyzstan is sown in September-October (FAO Crop Calendar). After that it can be planned for next season only if it is already in the ground
